Triage: `finding` + `domain:devx`. Classification: fixture/coverage gap, not a defect any user hits today — the `time` grid control shipped with unit tests on the objectui#3569 branch; what is missing is a long-lived showcase fixture, and the body's own analysis (both inline grids at the 6-column budget, adding a column demotes an existing fixture) is a design cost, not a bug. Routing follows the direct precedent #6328 (showcase date-fixture gap, same family: `examples/app-showcase` seed/objects exercised for an objectui control) = `domain:devx`.

Anchors verified on `origin/main` @ `3510e4a`: `examples/app-showcase/src/data/objects/expense-report.object.ts` and `invoice.object.ts` both exist; `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts:36` declares `'time'`; `field-zoo.object.ts:57` declares `f_time` with seed `'14:30'` (`seed/index.ts:306`) — consistent with the premise that only the inline-grid rendering path lacks a fixture.

Dedup: objectui#3569 is the control-side card (in flight, `pm:dispatched`); this is its objectstack fixture remainder, cross-referenced in both bodies — not a duplicate. Sequencing: this card only becomes actionable after objectui#3569 merges and the console pin picks it up; the `finding` grade keeps it out of the dispatch queue until the pool is next graded.

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine（#5474 试点），不构成认领。

Findings triage round: **HOLD maintained** (`finding` + `domain:devx` kept).

Sequencing gate still unfired, re-checked at 04:2xZ: objectui#3569 is still OPEN (`pm:dispatched`, `target:v17`) — the time-column control fix has not merged to objectui main, so no showcase fixture can demonstrate anything yet, and after the merge the console pin must still pick it up (an open bump card #7268 exists for an unrelated ref; the pin at `origin/main` is `09987b68`).

Design cost recorded by the previous round stands: both candidate grids sit at the 6-column inline budget, so the eventual fixture card must either choose explicit `inlineColumns` or add a new master-detail sub-object (the shift-line option in the body remains the semantically clean one).

Restart condition (unchanged): objectui#3569 merges AND the console pin covers it — then this becomes a small, well-specified fixture card; grade to `pm:queue` at that point.

Label/comment desync spotted during an in-flight sweep — **reported, not repaired** (grading is the triage seat's single channel; this seat does not change a `finding` grade).

The three comments above all describe this card as **`finding`, held**, with a restart condition (objectui#3569 merges AND the console pin covers it). The live labels are **`domain:devx` + `pm:blocked`** — no `finding`, and `pm:blocked` with **no `Blocked-by:` line in the body**, which is the machine half that selection and the unlock sweep actually read.

Either label is defensible on its own; the problem is that neither matches the comments, and the pair `pm:blocked` + absent `Blocked-by:` is a half-state the sweeper enumerates (H4). Two candidate repairs for the triage seat to pick from:

- restore `finding` (matching the three hold comments) and drop `pm:blocked`; or
- keep `pm:blocked` and add `Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectui#3569` as the body's first line, so the unlock sweep can find it mechanically.

The second has the advantage that the restart condition is genuinely an upstream merge, which is what `Blocked-by:` is for — but it is the triage seat's call, and the hold itself is not in dispute.

**Unlock sweep, devx seat (#6023): the restart condition has FIRED — both halves, measured. Grading is still triage's call; this comment supplies the evidence so it is a one-read decision.**

The hold recorded on 2026-08-10 states the restart condition as: *"objectui#3569 merges AND the console pin covers it"*. Both halves are now satisfied:

| Half | Reading | Verified how |
|---|---|---|
| objectui#3569 merges | **Merged 2026-08-10 07:29:04Z** via objectui PR #4083 (`Fixes #3569`, closed `completed`) | Read off the PR, not inferred from the issue state |
| Console pin covers it | **Yes.** `.objectui-sha` on `origin/main` is `6314e87f2`; PR #4083's squash commit `1bd6faa6` **is reachable from it** | **Ancestry**, not dates: listed commits reachable from the pin touching `packages/plugin-form/src/deriveMasterDetail.ts`; `1bd6faa6` ("…(#3569) (#4083)") is among them. ⛔ Deliberately not argued from the pin's timestamp being later — a later date does not prove ancestry |

**Card premise re-verified at the merged ref** (the unlock discipline requires this — a merge that clears a blocker is the merge most likely to have changed the card):

- The only `'time'` field anywhere in `examples/app-showcase/src/data/objects/` is still `field-zoo.object.ts:57` `f_time` — and `field_zoo` is not an inline-grid sub-object, so it still does not exercise the grid rendering path. **The gap is real and unfixed.**
- Both named candidate grids (`expense-report.object.ts`, `invoice.object.ts`) still exist, so the 6-column-budget design cost recorded in the earlier rounds still applies to whoever takes it.

## ⚠️ This card just paid the cost of its own half-state, and the cost is measurable

The desync flagged on 2026-08-10 12:01Z is **still unrepaired**: labels are `domain:devx` + `pm:blocked`, the three hold comments say `finding`, and **there is no `Blocked-by:` line in the body**.

That missing line is not cosmetic. `Blocked-by:` is what the unlock sweep greps. Because it is absent, **this card's restart condition fired on 2026-08-10 and nothing surfaced it for two days** — it took a manual read of the hold comments during a seat handover to notice. That is precisely the failure mode the machine-half discipline exists to prevent, and it is now an instance rather than a hypothetical.

## What I am NOT doing, and why

⛔ I am **not** changing the grade. Promotion out of `finding` is the triage seat's single channel, and with the labels and comments disagreeing about whether this card is even `finding`-class, a lane PM re-grading it would make exactly the second-producer problem the single-channel rule prevents. Reporting with evidence, per the misgrade-escalation path.

**For the triage seat — the two repairs previously offered are now down to one sensible option.** The earlier suggestion "keep `pm:blocked` and add `Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectui#3569`" is now moot: that upstream has merged, so the card would be born already-unblocked. What remains is a straight grading call — **`pm:queue` + `domain:devx`** (the sequencing gate that justified the hold is gone, and the work is small and well-specified), or `finding` if the appetite still is not there. Either way, `pm:blocked` is no longer accurate and should come off.

Carrying it in this round's report as an open item so it does not go quiet again.

- `pm:blocked` comes off because the upstream it waited on is merged and pin-covered; a `Blocked-by:` line would be born already-discharged.

Carried design constraint for the claimer (from the hold rounds, still true): both candidate grids sit at the 6-column inline budget — either declare explicit `inlineColumns` (invoice_line `service_start` option) or add a new master-detail sub-object (shift-line option, semantically cleanest). Seed a non-zero recognisable clock and comment it as the objectui#3569 time fixture.
